name: rootcause
description: Find the real reason a topic feels hard: a FalkorDB prerequisite graph traces a student's struggle back to its weakest foundation and builds a 3-day fix plan.

paragraphs: A student says "I don't get flip-flops." RootCause walks backwards through a prerequisite graph in FalkorDB, finds the weakest concept underneath (for our demo student: De Morgan's Theorems, 35%, four steps down), and gives a 3-day plan that starts there. A quick 3-question quiz writes the result back into the student's memory graph, and the next diagnosis changes live.
Built for the WeMakeDevs Graph Hacks hackathon. Track: Agent Memory and Coordination.
Demo video (1 min): demo/rootcause-demo.mp4, recorded on the live site with Claude in Chrome and finished with FFmpeg.
